description.narrative: The aim of the Gender for Equality (GefD) programme is to reduce poverty and gender discrimination by strengthening partner countries' capacity to develop and implement legislation and policies that in turn improve women's rights and gender equality. The GEfD programme will focus on technical cooperation on gender equality between Norway and authorities in countries that demand capacity and institutional development in this area. It will contribute to the sharing of experiences and expertise between institutions at government level with the view to enhance policies and their implementation to advance gender equality in the countries were we cooperate. Bufdir and Statistics Norway play a key role in the planning and implementation of the programme from the Norwegian side. The agreement is with Bufdir, which coordinates implementation, and technical inputs from Statistics Norway. To solve a societal challenge such as discrimination against girls and women, one must have good understanding of what is the problem and what is the current situation. Statistics and analysis are crucial to know whether measures developed and implemented are meeting the needs, are relevant and have the desired effect. Norwegian institutions such as Bufdir and Statistics Norway have relevant experience which they bring to the table in the cooperation with relevant national partnering organizations such as national statistical offices and relevant ministries working to enhance gender equality in the respective societies. The agreement with Bufdir revolves around institutional cooperation with gender equality institutions in Uganda and Nepal. Furthermore, Norad cooperates with Bufdir on integrating gender equality into other knowledge programmes, including in Colombia. Institutional cooperation with Ministry of Gender Labour and Social Development in Uganda, and scoping possibilities for institutional cooperation with authorities in Tanzania, Zanzibar to advance women's rights.
